title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 041
review_goal: Differentiate aiming, airpods, and alarm variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Crosshair target ring with four outer ticks and one centered dot
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a crosshair style target with one center dot and four outer ticks.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the bullseye target when inner rings matter more than a single center dot.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows one outer ring, four short ticks, and one solid dot at the center.

items.depicts_observation: Bullseye target with two concentric ring circles and four outer ticks around a centered dot
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a bullseye target with two inner rings inside the crosshair frame.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the single dot crosshair when the center should read as a filled dot instead of a ring.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces the center dot with two concentric rings while keeping the outer target ticks.

items.depicts_observation: Two separate earbud stem shapes facing inward across the center
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants two loose earbuds rather than a case or charger shape.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the charging case icon when the main shape should be a rounded box.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows two mirrored earbud stems standing apart with no outer case around them.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded charging case with a lid line and one centered latch
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a rounded earbud charging case with a clear lid seam.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the loose earbuds icon when no outer case should be visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is a rounded rectangle case with a horizontal lid seam and one latch shape in front.

items.depicts_observation: Twin bell alarm clock with two feet and short hands inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a classic twin bell alarm clock with feet at the bottom.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the simpler round alarm when the floating bells and feet are not present.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a round clock body with two top bells, two feet, and short hands inside.
